What is your favorite part of BotW?

I had a fight a while ago. It was a camp of bokolibins in their skull shaped cave. Sentry towers of archers all around. There was no way I could survive a direct onslaught. Ultimately after many attempts, I ended up sniping one side of the archers, getting around the the skull rock, climbing it, sniping the rest of the archers, dropping a bomb thru the eye of the skull cave, blowing up a couple of the weak guys, retreating to the top of the skull, then throwing another bomb in the eye, blowing up the group again, and luring the goblins away 1-2 at a time and clearing the camp. This experience was probably the first time that I really started using the various abilities, bombs, stasis, arrows and really hammered home the concept of being flexible and using every ability possible.

My 2nd favorite part was when I restarted the game after completing it, will full hearts/stamina etc. and seeing exactly how hostile and dangerous the world is when you don't have 25+ heart containers and fully upgraded armor etc. As odd as it may sound, that feeling of vulnerability and fear of death of a new run, no good weapons /armor / low health, having to fight moblins and camps, knowing when it's time to flee and regroup then reengage. It's a feeling that I wish persisted more into the later stages of the game.
I'll never forget my first camp assaults. Thank goodness for unlimited bombs!

So, full disclosure, Wii-U player here.

My favorite thing is how there are decent lengths of land with nothing useful in them.

My "first love" video game was OoT, and I would get lost in Hyrule, wander around and look at things, with no particular aim in mind. When I did, the plot and pressure of being The Hero of Time receded away from me.

It's less true, overall, in BotW. But I still have some nooks and crannies--not huge swaths, but still, enough to duck into--where I'm just some kid wandering around Hyrule.

Love it. x.x
